pr_title: Fix spectator not starting from current player position
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/17267.

Changes to `PlayerLoader` are only required for testing. Can be split out into a separate PR if preferred, but I didn't bother because they are file (and commit) level isolated.

I think reading through the changes and attempting to understand from code is best (if it isn't 100% straightforward what has changed and why then I think further refactor may be required) so I'm not going to overly explain this one.
pr_comments: Note that I haven't touched the fact that in the first frame after `LoadComplete`, `Player` is not-present. I honestly don't know if that should be fixed or how to fix it (there's probably other screens in a similar scenario) so ensured the solution offered here doesn't rely on that part anymore.

I've made quite serious changes as I misunderstood the constructor parameter initially (or missed it). Note that while this is still fine for review purposes, I'm still stacking one remaining test issue, which is that `TestSceneMultiplayerPlayer` will occasionally fail (both the ctor and the test method): ```csharp TearDown : System.AggregateException : One or more errors occurred. (StartGameplay should not be called when the gameplay clock is already running) ----> System.InvalidOperationException : StartGameplay should not be called when the gameplay clock is already running --TearDown at System.Threading.Tasks.Task.ThrowIfExceptional(Boolean includeTaskCanceledExceptions) at System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Wait(Int32 millisecondsTimeout, CancellationToken cancellationToken) at System.Threading.Tasks.Task.Wait() at osu.Framework.Extensions.TaskExtensions.WaitSafely(Task task) at osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene.checkForErrors() at osu.Framework.Testing.TestScene.RunTestsFromNUnit() --InvalidOperationException at osu.Game.Screens.Play.Player.StartGameplay() in /Users/dean/Projects/osu/osu.Game/Screens/Play/Player.cs:line 982 at osu.Game.Screens.OnlinePlay.Multiplayer.MultiplayerPlayer.b__22_0() in /Users/dean/Projects/osu/osu.Game/Screens/OnlinePlay/Multiplayer/MultiplayerPlayer.cs:line 179 at osu.Framework.Threading.ScheduledDelegate.InvokeTask() at osu.Framework.Threading.ScheduledDelegate.RunTaskInternal() at osu.Framework.Threading.Scheduler.Update() at osu.Framework.Graphics.Drawable.UpdateSubTree() ``` If someone beats me to figuring out why I will not complain. Initial thought is that the clock may be running when entering multiplayer, even when the loading isn't complete (for one reason or another).
This is ready for review again ._.

[Two](https://github.com/ppy/osu/runs/5671658212?check_suite_focus=true) [of](https://github.com/ppy/osu/runs/5671658249?check_suite_focus=true) the test failures look like they may be related to these changes, but honestly I don't know how. Can't repro locally but I'll leave running in a hope to manage to.

Test failures are related to the windows-specific platform offset being applied. Not yet sure on whether this is more or less correct. Maybe @frenzibyte will be able to come to a conclusion quicker than I can.

https://github.com/ppy/osu/runs/5846066167?check_suite_focus=true#step:6:1127
I've applied your proposed fixes with some minor changes. Seems good, and makes sense 👍 .
Apologies for force push, stuff got very mixed up (shouldn't affect review as it was done quickly).
Not sure if the `TestScenePause` failure is something we've seen before...
Yeah I'm not sure. Unless anyone has bright ideas I'd probably go forward with merge and see how often it pops up...

issue_context.title: Spectating mid-gameplay no longer seeks to first received frame time
issue_context.body:
Regressed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/17026/commits/bb8caabb8be3e0391fee7adede8f0bed09948737 due to `MasterGameplayClockContainer` resetting current time on `LoadComplete` rather than BDL. `SpectatorPlayer` can receive the first frame and seek to it before `MasterGameplayClockContainer` reaches `LoadComplete` state, therefore, after https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/17026/commits/bb8caabb8be3e0391fee7adede8f0bed09948737, `MasterGameplayClockContainer` would overwrite any seeks done before `LoadComplete`, and regress spectating mid-gameplay. I'm unsure about a solution to this, perhaps the sanest would be to schedule the first frame seek in `SpectatorPlayer` to run after `Player` updates children (i.e. `ScheduleAfterChildren`) ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/17266
Originally posted by **minasminas** March 16, 2022 The singleplayer spectate doesn't seem to work anymore. It did work a few weeks ago (don't know which update broke it). Multiplayer spectate is working good as usual by the way. While testing this issue I also made sure that the user is really playing the map and isn't in the menus or pausing. Here is a short video of the issue: https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/81645139/158482669-6692fe95-93f8-4b8b-a445-d02811147468.mp4 Logs: [performance.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8257473/performance.log) [runtime.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8257475/runtime.log) [updater.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8257476/updater.log) [database.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8257477/database.log) [network.log](https://github.com/ppy/osu/files/8257478/network.log)
comments: Guessing this is probably also causing all the recent test failures...?

Indeed now that I look at [this one](https://github.com/ppy/osu/runs/5561977171?check_suite_focus=true)... never thought that to be relevant. The interesting part is that it's intermittent, would've thought that to always fail on all platforms.

One thing I'm unsure about here is how does the flow that @frenzibyte proposed actually occur? The `OnNewFrames` call is `Scheduled` at a `SpectatorClient` level:

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/67082b8c5de9d97d353ea973f34bc6773af4029f/osu.Game/Online/Spectator/SpectatorClient.cs#L155

Which while being at the wrong component, this would guarantee the gameplay screen to have loaded along with all children at this point, no?

`Player.OnEntering` -> `StartGameplay` -> `OnNewFrames +=` -> `Player.LoadComplete` / `Player.UpdateSubTree.loadChild` -> `SpectatorClient.Scheduler.Update` is what I'm seeing.

The reason behind that is actually interesting: [`Player` sets its alpha to 0 at `OnEntering` to fade in](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/2eb3365f463618a8679a2ba4a06418bc44b1e4c8/osu.Game/Screens/Play/Player.cs#L926), but that causes it to have `IsPresent = false` on the first (current) frame, therefore delaying updating its children until next frame (see [`CompositeDrawable.UpdateSubTree`](https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/blob/108c36ef5e23e6842d49fd03c603d34d63972bac/osu.Framework/Graphics/Containers/CompositeDrawable.cs#L906-L908)). 

And in that single frame window, `SpectatorClient` updates its scheduler and executes the scheduled `OnNewFrames`, therefore causing `userSentFrames` to be executed before `MasterGameplayClockContainer` gets loaded.

Jesus. I saw that `Alpha` set and was definitely suspicious of it.

Solving this isolated failure is easy enough, but this level of critical failure makes it feel like we need to reexamine things at another level.

review_comments: Shouldn't this reset the offset if `false`? The config is persistent in the test scene.
I thought the use of `LocalStorage` here was enough. I'll double-check.
This whole scene is marked `[HeadlessTest]`, so this shouldn't be an issue.

I did consider that this is a headless test, but it depends on the ordering of events. Like if nunit ever reorders tests to run an `== true` test before an `== false`, then it's going to be in the wrong state. Rider likes to reorder its tests so...

Guess we can roll with it if you disagree, it's more of a correctness thing.
Fair, I've added a reset before each test run.
